form.label: SOC Case Management - ServiceNow Demo
form.description: Daily SOC case-management queue using synthetic ServiceNow incidents for Splunk Enterprise Security demos.

div.p: Monitor open ServiceNow INCs, Mission Control findings, SOC queue assignment, and cross-platform linkage.

html.div: KPI labels: Open Cases | MC Findings | Linked INCs | High / Critical Open | Avg Open Age Hours

search.query: index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident active=true | stats count as value
index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | stats count as value

single.title: Linked INCs

search.query: index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | stats dc(snow_incident_number) as value

single.option: ES source rows tied to ServiceNow

search.query: index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident priority IN ("1 - Critical","2 - High") active=true | stats count as value
index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident active=true | eval age_hours=(now()-_time)/3600 | stats avg(age_hours) as value | eval value=round(value,1)

table.title: Mission Control Findings Linked to ServiceNow INCs

search.query: index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | eval service_now_inc=snow_incident_number, mc_finding_title=name, detection_name=correlation_search, mc_urgency=urgency, mc_severity=severity, mc_owner=assignee, mc_status=status_name | join type=left service_now_inc [ search index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident | eval service_now_inc=number | stats latest(priority) AS inc_priority latest(state) AS inc_state latest(assigned_to) AS inc_assignee latest(short_description) AS inc_summary BY service_now_inc ] | eval linkage=case(isnotnull(inc_state) AND isnotnull(mc_finding_title), "Mission Control + ServiceNow", isnotnull(inc_state), "ServiceNow only", isnotnull(mc_finding_title), "MC queue item", 1=1, "Unlinked") | table _time soc_queue service_now_inc notable_id mc_finding_title detection_name mc_urgency mc_severity mc_owner mc_status inc_priority inc_state inc_assignee risk_object cmdb_ci business_service linkage | sort soc_queue - _time

index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | eval service_now_inc=snow_incident_number | table _time name correlation_search urgency severity assignee status_name service_now_inc notable_id soc_queue risk_object cmdb_ci business_service | rename name AS title, correlation_search AS rule_name, assignee AS owner, status_name AS status | sort - _time

chart.title: Mission Control Source Events by SOC Queue

search.query: index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident | stats count AS Findings by soc_queue | sort - Findings

index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident | search active=true | eval age_hours=round((now()-_time)/3600,1) | table _time number priority state assigned_to cmdb_ci business_service age_hours short_description | sort priority - _time
index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident earliest=-7d@d | bin _time span=1d | stats count as Cases by _time | eval Day=strftime(_time, "%a %m/%d") | sort _time | table Day Cases

index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident | eval State=coalesce(state, "Unknown") | stats count as Cases by State | eval sort_order=case(State="New",1, State="In Progress",2, State="On Hold",3, State="Resolved",4, State="Closed",5, true(),99) | sort sort_order | fields State Cases

table.title: ServiceNow INCs with Splunk Notable IDs

search.query: index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident u_splunk_notable_event_id=* | table _time number priority state cmdb_ci business_service u_splunk_notable_event_id u_splunk_correlation_search u_mitre_tactic u_mitre_technique | sort - _time

table.title: Assets and Business Services with Case Activity

search.query: index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident | stats count values(priority) as priorities values(state) as states by cmdb_ci business_service | sort - count
